identity.title: Ongoing flyby in the young multiple system UX Tauri

paper_type_evidence.quote: In this Letter we present SPHERE images of the UX Tauri multiple system.
In §[2](#sec:observations) we present new SPHERE high-contrast coronagraphic images and archival ALMA data.

evidence.quote: It is located in the Taurus molecular cloud at d = $147\pm2$ pc (cite: GAIA-DR2-2018).

question.value: Is the spiral structure in the UX Tau A disk caused by a recent flyby of UX Tau C or by a bound companion orbit?

evidence.quote: We now test the hypothesis that the spirals observed UX Tau A are due to the dynamical response of the disk to a gravitational perturbation by UX Tau C.
presented archival deep and high-resolution data obtained by program 2015.1.00888.S (PI Akiyama).
The left insert is a zoom of the Band 7 (0.84mm) continuum emission showing the ringed structure of the disk at that frequency.
This program included $^{12}$CO (3-2) line emission data that we use here as well.

results_numeric.quantity: Projected separation of UX Tau C from A

evidence.quote: UX Tau C has a projected separation of 2.70$''$$\pm$0.02$''$ at PA = 181.5$^\circ$$\pm$1.0$^\circ$

results_numeric.quantity: Inclination of UX Tau C disk

evidence.quote: SPHERE marginally resolved the disk of UX Tau C and the inclination is i$\geq$60$^\circ$.
The orbital period is of order 7000 yr in our simulations.

findings_qualitative.value: Scattered-light spirals of UX Tau A have counterparts in 12CO; disks of A and C have misaligned velocity gradients

evidence.quote: The rotational velocity gradients of the two disks are misaligned.

claims.hypothesis: UX Tau C is a recent flyby perturber rather than a bound companion
claims.experiment: SPH bound and parabolic runs compared with SPHERE and ALMA CO spirals
claims.result: Prograde flyby gives prominent long-lived spirals; bound orbits truncate disk and spirals fade after a few orbits

evidence.quote: In summary, the ensemble of multiwavelength observational constraints available very clearly favors the flyby scenario.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Bound orbit gives a decent match only during the first few orbits

evidence.quote: A bound orbit solution can also provide a decent qualitative match, but only during the first few orbits.

limitations_admitted.value: Simulations cannot reproduce the outer southwest CO spiral; orbital geometry is degenerate

evidence.loc: 4.1 UX Tau C: Bound companion or flyby
evidence.quote: Our simulations are unable to reproduce the outer spiral located to the southwest
